name: Speedtest-Tracker
description: Runs internet speed tests on a schedule and charts the results

paths.name: Config
paths.description: The SQLite database with every test result, and .app_key, this install's own key made on first start. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Speedtest Tracker web UI and API, published on host as 6768

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: SPEEDTEST_SCHEDULE
variables.description: When to run a test, in cron format. 0 */6 * * * is every 6 hours; 0 * * * * is every hour. Leave it empty to only test when you click.

variables.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: The email you sign in with. Only used when the first user is made.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The first user's password. Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Only used when the first user is made.
